svg.title: Inference Engineering, from Scratch
svg.desc: A free, open course on how large language models are served: GPU memory, kernels, KV caches, batching and routing, with explanations, animations and runnable code. A sketch shows weights streaming from HBM memory into compute cores to produce one token.

g.text: How LLMs are served, from GPU memory to KV caches,
batching and routing. Explained, animated, coded.
fig. 0: every token re-reads every weight
